facts.fact: The ODPC bulletin states that as of March 2025 the Office had received 7,128 complaints and resolved 97 percent, issued 215 determinations, imposed penalties on 10 entities, issued 103 compensations and settled 39 other cases through ADR (a cumulative count, no single year stated).

The bulletin shows the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner acting under Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait, with offices in Nairobi, Kisumu, Mombasa, Eldoret, Machakos, Nyeri and Nakuru, registering data handlers and investigating complaints within 90 days.
